project_name: ProjectPulse AI - Student Final Year AI Project Ideator & Roadmap Platform

persona_and_vibe.archetype: The Performance Pro + Swiss High-Contrast Developer Precision
persona_and_vibe.tone: Empowering, sharp, structured, hyper-focused, AI-native editorial clarity
persona_and_vibe.design_philosophy: Fusion over imitation. Blend high-density developer tools with clean editorial typography, subtle micro-border animations, and interactive milestone roadmaps. Zero fluff, maximum clarity.

rules.anti_default: DO NOT use Inter or Arial for main H1/H2 headings. Use Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit for display text.
rules.caption: text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-medium text-muted-foreground
rules.tight_tracking: Always apply tracking-tight to headings above 28px

spacing_and_layout.mobile_first: Always start grid-cols-1 on mobile and scale to md:grid-cols-2 or lg:grid-cols-12
spacing_and_layout.border_padding_rule: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

splash_welcome_page.features: 5-second auto-transition to Home, visual progress bar, skip button, animated AI glowing emblem, tagline 'Transforming Tech Interests into Impactful Capstones'.

navigation_header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/50 px-4 py-3
elements: Nav links: Dashboard/Home, Idea Generator, Public Implementations, Roadmap & Milestones, Mentorship
Student Profile badge with current user name and avatar

sections: Welcome Banner with Student Name, Major, Expected Graduation, and Capstone Status
Daily Activities & Learning Metrics Widget (streak count, hours logged, github commits synced, skills matrix)
Call to Action: 'Generate New Project Idea' button vs 'Continue Current Roadmap'
Community Project Feed: Showcases real or inspirational projects completed by other senior students with filters (Domain, Tech Stack, Likes, GitHub links)

steps.title: Interests & Domain Preferences
fields: Core Domains (AI/ML, Web3, Cloud & DevOps, IoT, Mobile, HealthTech)
Personal Interests / Real-world problems eager to solve

ai_generator_multistep_form.validation: Form fields must have validation (zod / react-hook-form) with active feedback, accessible field messages, and step progress indicator.

card_elements: Match Score (% based on skills & interests)
Key Highlight / Why It Fits Student Profile

sections: Hero Banner with Title, Problem Statement, and Architecture Overview
Recommended Tech Stack Matrix (Matched directly to student's known skills + 1 learnable stretch tech)
Phased Development Roadmap (Phase 1: Architecture & Data, Phase 2: MVP Core, Phase 3: Integration & AI, Phase 4: Testing & Deployment)
2-3 Concrete Differentiation / Improvement Ideas (How to make it publishable/commercialized)

features: Phase-by-Phase Checklist with status toggles (Not Started, In Progress, Completed)
Automated Progress Report Generator (Generates PDF/Markdown summary for faculty guide submission)
Log Activity button to record weekly progress
Quick prompt chips ('How do I write project proposal?', 'Explain system architecture', 'Suggest datasets for my topic')
Live conversation chat window with AI response stream simulation
Context aware (knows current selected project and student skills)

images.description: Group of university students collaborating around a laptop in a modern study hall
Developer setup with modern dark coding environment
Code display screen with clean IDE layout

rules: Hover states on interactive cards: transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg
Entrance animations: Fade-in and subtle slide-up (y: 10 to y: 0, opacity: 0 to 1)
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all scroll and entrance animations
No universal transition: all in CSS. Use explicit transitions like transition-colors or transition-transform

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, modal triggers, card CTAs, tab triggers) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case format. E.g., data-testid='generate-ideas-btn', data-testid='milestone-check-1', data-testid='theme-toggle-button'.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Ensure WCAG AA contrast for text elements. Subtitles over backgrounds must use semi-solid backing or contrast text-shadow where appropriate.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Focus rings must be clearly visible on buttons and form elements on tab focus.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the React JavaScript structure (.js files) as present in the repo.
Use Lucide React icons for UI iconography.
Implement JWT-based mock/real authentication state so students can switch profiles or login.
Ensure the splash screen auto-navigates to Home after 5 seconds but includes a clear 'Skip to App' button.
Provide seed student ideas in the public feed initially so the page feels rich and inhabited.
Make the AI chatbot widget interactive with preset sample queries and AI response streaming animations.
